sources.citation: Oliveira, Sandra. 2018. Inferring the demographic history of southern Angola: a key region for understanding human settlement in southern Africa. PhD thesis, Universidade do Porto (repositorio-aberto.up.pt handle 10216/118846).
sources.note: Nothing; population genetics with a 600-item-wordlist lexicostatistical analysis of Kuvale and neighbours (Fehn's field data); no phonology or prosody.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2015. Change Request 2015-064 and New Code Request form for [olu] Kuvale (submitted by Linda Jordan, SIL).
sources.note: Nothing; classification, intelligibility, lexical similarity, sociolinguistics, bibliography (Jordan 2015; Jordan & Manuel 2015 forthcoming; Pfouts 2003; Sullivan 1983 unpublished).

sources.citation: Jordan, Linda. 2015. A Comparison of Five Speech Varieties of Southwestern Angola: Comparing OluHumbe, OluCilenge, OluKwandu, OluNgendelengo, and OluKuvale in the Kamucuio Municipality, Namibe Province. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2015-017. Dallas: SIL International. iii+29 pp. (SIL entry 64363; PDF fetched sources via Wayback id_ capture of the sil.org reapdata URL)
sources.note: Nothing. Contents: lexicostatistics, noun classes, sec. 4.3 'Overview of segmental correspondences', diagnostic items, 600-item wordlists. Only prosodic remark, sec. 4.3 p.7: 'Tone is not covered in this paper in order to focus on the segmental correspondences.' Wordlists carry no tone or stress marks.
